paragraphs: Opti sells a cloud-based platform for stormwater management. Its Continuous Monitoring and Adaptive Control solution optimizes the collection, storage, and treatment of stormwater runoff. The home page describes real-time sensor data and forecast information feeding automated controls on stormwater infrastructure.

The products page lists browser-based dashboards with real-time and historic data, event separation for reporting, and third-party data integrations. Automated predictive control is listed with 90+ adjustable configuration settings, together with coordinated release that controls upstream releases based on downstream environmental conditions. Services listed there include feasibility assessments, design support, hydrologic and hydraulic modeling, software configurations, and site management, inspection, and maintenance for certified hardware.

The featured project on the home page names the City of Albany and Albany Water Supply. The about page states that by 2020 the company was helping cities like Albany, NY, reduce sewage overflows using a coordinated system. Regulatory compliance covering MS4, CSO, and development is listed among the challenges the company addresses.

quote.text: Opti technology helps us identify existing conditions and develop strategies to adapt to a changing environment.
